description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'CreateCatalogItemEndpoint' for creating new catalog items in the eShopWeb application. It implements route mapping, request handling, validation, and response construction related to catalog item creation, utilizing repositories, specifications, and DTOs.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for creating catalog items, including route setup and request handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Defines the POST route for creating catalog items, including authorization and request delegate.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the incoming request, checks for duplicates, creates a new catalog item, updates its picture URI, and constructs the response.
